news.title: Fire damages Canton home; occupants escape, dog missing
news.summary: A fire broke out at a home on North Etowah Drive in Canton shortly after 5 a.m., spreading from the garage to the main level and attic, Cherokee Fire said.

news.title: FBI is investigating reports of an 'incendiary device' being thrown at an ICE building in Atlanta
news.summary: The FBI says an "incendiary device" was thrown at an ICE building in Atlanta Tuesday night.

news.title: VIDEO: Atlanta Police asking public to identify suspect in connection to deadly shooting of 25-year-old man
news.summary: Elijah Brookshire, 25, died after a shooting in September on Cushman Circle in southwest Atlanta.

news.title: Decomposed pet found on Cartersville doorstep, man arrested
news.summary: A Cartersville man was arrested after police said he left his about to be ex-wife's dead, decomposed dog in a crate on her boyfriend's doorstep alongside a threatening message.
